questions.stem:
14. A vessel in the form of a frustum which is made by cutting off the lower part of an inverted right circular cone of base radius \(72\) cm and height \(96\) cm. The height of the vessel is \(60\) cm. The vessel is placed on a horizontal table. Some water is now poured into the vessel. John finds that the depth of water in the vessel is \(28\) cm.

(a) Find the area of the wet curved surface of the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) John claims that the volume of water in the vessel is greater than \(0.1\text{ m}^3\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個截頭錐形容器，由切除一個底半徑 \(72\) cm、高 \(96\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐的下部而成。容器的高度為 \(60\) cm，放在水平桌上。現將一些水倒入容器，John 發現水深為 \(28\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求容器的濕曲面面積。

(b) John 聲稱容器中的水體積大於 \(0.1\text{ m}^3\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: The water surface is \(60-28=32\) cm below the top of the vessel, so it is \(96-60+28=64\) cm from the vertex of the original cone. Let \(R\) cm be the radius of the water surface. By similarity, \(\frac{R}{72}=\frac{64}{96},\) so \(R=48.\) The lower cut is \(96-60=36\) cm from the vertex. Let its radius be \(r\). Then \(\frac{r}{72}=\frac{36}{96},\) so \(r=27.\) (a) The wet curved surface area is \[\pi(48)\sqrt{48^2+64^2}-\pi(27)\sqrt{27^2+36^2}.\] Thus \[=\pi(48)(80)-\pi(27)(45)=2625\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] (b) The volume of water is \[\frac13\pi(48)^2(64)-\frac13\pi(27)^2(36) =40404\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Since \[40404\pi\text{ cm}^3\approx0.1269\text{ m}^3>0.1\text{ m}^3,\] the claim is agreed. Final answers: (a) \(2625\pi\text{ cm}^2\); (b) agree.

11. An inverted right circular conical vessel contains some milk. The vessel is held vertically. The depth of milk in the vessel is \(12\) cm. Peter then pours \(444\pi\text{ cm}^3\) of milk into the vessel without overflowing. He now finds that the depth of milk in the vessel is \(16\) cm.

(a) Express the final volume of milk in the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Peter claims that the final area of the wet curved surface of the vessel is at least \(800\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(6 marks)
questions.stemZh:
11. 一個倒置直立圓錐形容器盛有一些牛奶，容器垂直放置。牛奶的深度為 \(12\) cm。Peter 再倒入 \(444\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 牛奶而沒有溢出，他發現牛奶深度變為 \(16\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示容器中牛奶的最終體積。

(b) Peter 聲稱容器的濕曲面面積最少為 \(800\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（6 分）
questions.hint: Calculate the values, then compare with the claim. State agree/disagree clearly.
questions.hintZh: 先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: (a) Let \(V\text{ cm}^3\) be the final volume of milk. By similarity, \[\frac{V-444\pi}{V}=\left(\frac{12}{16}\right)^3.\] Solving gives \[V=768\pi.\] (b) Let \(r\) be the final radius of the surface of milk. Then \[\frac13\pi r^2(16)=768\pi,\] so \[ r=12. \] The final wet curved surface area is \[\pi(12)\sqrt{12^2+16^2}=240\pi\approx754\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \(240\pi<800\), the claim is disagreed. Final answers: (a) \(768\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b) disagree.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）設最終牛奶體積 V。由相似：
\[
\frac{V-444\pi}{V}=\left(\frac{12}{16}\right)^3.
\]
解得 V = 768π。
（b）設水面半徑 r：
\[
\frac13\pi r^2(16)=768\pi,\quad r=12.
\]
最終濕曲面：
\[
\pi(12)\sqrt{12^2+16^2}=240\pi\approx754\text{ cm}^2.
\]
240π < 800，不同意聲稱。

13. \(ABCD\) is a trapezium with \(\angle ABC=90^\circ\) and \(AB\parallel DC\). \(E\) is a point lying on \(BC\) such that \(\angle AED=90^\circ\).

(a) Prove that \(\triangle ABE\sim\triangle ECD\).

(b) It is given that \(AB=15\) cm, \(AE=25\) cm and \(CE=36\) cm.

(i) Find the length of \(CD\).
(ii) Find the area of \(\triangle ADE\).
(iii) Is there a point \(F\) lying on \(AD\) such that the distance between \(E\) and \(F\) is less than \(23\) cm? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. \(ABCD\) 為梯形，\(\angle ABC=90^\circ\) 且 \(AB\parallel DC\)。\(E\) 為 \(BC\) 上的一點，使得 \(\angle AED=90^\circ\)。

(a) 證明 \(\triangle ABE\sim\triangle ECD\)。

(b) 已知 \(AB=15\) cm、\(AE=25\) cm 及 \(CE=36\) cm。

(i) 求 \(CD\) 的長度。
(ii) 求 \(\triangle ADE\) 的面積。
(iii) \(AD\) 上是否存在一點 \(F\)，使得 \(E\) 與 \(F\) 的距離小於 \(23\) cm？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Trapezium area = (a+b)h/2.
questions.solution: (a) Since \(AB\parallel DC\) and \(\angle ABC=90^\circ\), \[\angle ABE=\angle DCE=90^\circ.\] Also \(\angle AED=90^\circ\), so the remaining acute angles are equal. Hence \[\triangle ABE\sim\triangle ECD.\] (b)(i) \(BE=\sqrt{AE^2-AB^2}=\sqrt{25^2-15^2}=20\text{ cm}.\) By similarity, \(\frac{CD}{BE}=\frac{CE}{AB}\) so \(\frac{CD}{20}=\frac{36}{15}\) and \(CD=48\text{ cm}.\) (b)(ii) The area of \(\triangle ADE\) is \(\frac12(AB+CD)(BC)-\frac12(AB)(BE)-\frac12(CD)(CE)\) \(=\frac12(15+48)(20+36)-\frac12(15)(20)-\frac12(48)(36)=750\text{ cm}^2.\) (b)(iii) \(AD=\sqrt{BC^2+(CD-AB)^2} =\sqrt{56^2+33^2}=65\text{ cm}.\) The shortest distance from \(E\) to \(AD\) is \(\frac{2(750)}{65}=\frac{300}{13}\approx23.1\text{ cm}.\) Since this is greater than \(23\) cm, there is no such point \(F\). Final answers: (a) proved; (b)(i) \(48\) cm; (b)(ii) \(750\text{ cm}^2\); (b)(iii) no.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）AB ∥ DC 且 ∠ABC = 90°，故 ∠ABE = ∠DCE = 90°。又 ∠AED = 90°，其餘銳角相等，故 △ABE ∼ △ECD。
（b）（i）BE = √(25²−15²) = 20 cm。由相似：
\[
\frac{CD}{20}=\frac{36}{15},\quad CD=48\text{ cm}.
\]
（b）（ii）△ADE 面積：
\[
\frac12(15+48)(56)-\frac12(15)(20)-\frac12(48)(36)=750\text{ cm}^2.
\]
（b）（iii）AD = √(56²+33²) = 65 cm。E 至 AD 最短距離：
\[
\frac{2(750)}{65}=\frac{300}{13}\approx23.1\text{ cm}.
\]
大於 23 cm，不存在此點 F。

14. A right circular cylindrical container of base radius \(8\) cm and height \(64\) cm and an inverted right circular conical vessel of base radius \(20\) cm and height \(60\) cm are held vertically. The container is fully filled with water. The water in the container is now poured into the vessel.

(a) Find the volume of water in the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Find the depth of water in the vessel.

(c) If a solid metal sphere of radius \(14\) cm is then put into the vessel and the sphere is totally immersed in the water, will the water overflow? Explain your answer.
(9 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個底半徑 \(8\) cm、高 \(64\) cm 的直立圓柱形容器，與一個底半徑 \(20\) cm、高 \(60\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐形容器，均垂直放置。圓柱容器完全注滿水，現將水全部倒入圓錐容器。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求圓錐容器中水的體積。

(b) 求圓錐容器中水的深度。

(c) 若再將一個半徑 \(14\) cm 的實心金屬球放入圓錐容器中，且球完全浸入水中，水會否溢出？試解釋你的答案。
（9 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution: (a) \[V=\pi(8)^2(64)=4096\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) Let the depth of water be \(h\) cm. By similarity, the radius of the water surface is \(\frac h3\). Hence \[\frac13\pi\left(\frac h3\right)^2h=4096\pi.\] Thus \[h^3=110592\] and \[ h=48. \] (c) The capacity of the conical vessel is \[\frac13\pi(20)^2(60)=8000\pi.\] The volume not occupied by water is \[8000\pi-4096\pi=3904\pi.\] The volume of the metal sphere is \[\frac43\pi(14)^3=\frac{10976}{3}\pi.\] Since \[\frac{10976}{3}\pi<3904\pi,\] the water will not overflow. Final answers: (a) \(4096\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b) \(48\) cm; (c) no.

(a) 圓錐中間部分的體積；

14. Fig. 1 shows a cup \(VAB\) made from soft plastic sheets and in the shape of a right circular cone of base radius \(9\text{ cm}\) and height \(21\text{ cm}\). The dotted circle \(XY\) is parallel to the base and one-third of the height from the base.

(a) Find the volume of the frustum \(ABXY\).

(b) The lower portion \(VXY\) of the cone is now pushed up along circle \(XY\) to form the container in Fig. 2. If it is placed with its base horizontal and water is poured into it until overflows, find the amount of water in the container. Give both answers in terms of \(\pi\).
questions.stemZh:
14. 圖 1 顯示一個用軟膠片造成的杯 \(VAB\)，形狀為底半徑 \(9\) cm、高 \(21\) cm 的直立圓錐。虛線圓 \(XY\) 平行於底面，且與底面的距離為高度的三分之一。

(a) 求截頭錐 \(ABXY\) 的體積。

(b) 現將圓錐下部 \(VXY\) 沿圓 \(XY\) 向上推，造成圖 2 的容器。若將容器底平放，加水至溢出，求容器中的水量。兩個答案均以 \(\pi\) 表示。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution: The full cone has volume \(\frac13\pi(9^2)(21)=567\pi.\) Since \(XY\) is one-third of the height from the base, the smaller top cone has height \(14\text{ cm}\) and radius \(6\text{ cm}\). Its volume is \(\frac13\pi(6^2)(14)=168\pi.\) Hence the frustum \(ABXY\) has volume \(567\pi-168\pi=\boxed{399\pi\text{ cm}^3}.\) After the lower portion is pushed up, the container is a frustum with volume \(168\pi-21\pi=147\pi\) removed from the lower cone, so the water volume is \(399\pi-147\pi=\boxed{252\pi\text{ cm}^3}.\)
questions.solutionZh: 整錐體積 = (1/3)π(9²)(21) = 567π。XY 距底三分之一高，上方小錐高 14、半徑 6，體積 = 168π。截頭錐 ABXY = 567π − 168π = 399π cm³。下方推入後，下方小錐移除 168π − 21π = 147π，水體積 = 399π − 147π = 252π cm³。

questions.stem:
13. The height and the curved surface area of a solid metal right circular cone are \(24\) cm and \(260\pi\text{ cm}^2\) respectively.

(a) Find the base radius of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided by two planes which are parallel to its base. The top is a right circular cone \(X\), the middle is a frustum \(Y\) and the bottom is a frustum \(Z\). It is given that the ratio of the curved surface areas of \(X\), \(Y\) and \(Z\) is \(9:16:11\). Express the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的高及曲面面積分別為 \(24\) cm 及 \(260\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求圓錐的底半徑。

(b) 該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分：頂部為圓錐 \(X\)，中間為截頭錐 \(Y\)，底部為截頭錐 \(Z\)。已知 \(X\)、\(Y\)、\(Z\) 的曲面面積比為 \(9:16:11\)。以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的體積。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
questions.solution: (a) Let the base radius be \(r\) cm. The slant height is \[\sqrt{r^2+24^2}.\] Since the curved surface area is \(260\pi\), \[\pi r\sqrt{r^2+576}=260\pi.\] Hence \[r^2(r^2+576)=260^2.\] So \[r^4+576r^2-67600=0.\] This gives \[(r^2-100)(r^2+676)=0.\] Rejecting the negative value, \[r=\boxed{10\text{ cm}}.\] (b) The curved surface areas of \(X\), \(X+Y\) and the whole cone are in the ratio \[9:(9+16):(9+16+11)=9:25:36.\] Therefore, the corresponding linear ratio is \[ 3:5:6, \] and the corresponding volume ratio is \[27:125:216.\] The volume of the whole cone is \[\frac13\pi(10)^2(24)=800\pi.\] Thus \[V_Y=800\pi\cdot\frac{125-27}{216} =\boxed{\frac{9800\pi}{27}\text{ cm}^3}.\]

(a) Find the base radius of the smaller cone.

(b) Someone claims that the total surface area of the frustum formed is at least \(2500 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\).

questions.stemZh:
11. 考慮一個底半徑 \(15\) cm、高 \(40\) cm 的直立圓錐。沿平行於底面的平面，從原圓錐切除一個高 \(16\) cm 的小圓錐。

(a) 求小圓錐的底半徑。

(b) 某人聲稱所得截頭錐的總表面積最少為 \(2500\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.

截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。

questions.solution: (a) Let the base radius of the smaller cone be \(r\) cm. By similarity, \[\frac{r}{15}=\frac{16}{40},\] so \[r=\boxed{6}.\] (b) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{15^2+40^2}=5\sqrt{73}.\] The slant height of the smaller cone is \[\sqrt{6^2+16^2}=2\sqrt{73}.\] The curved surface area of the frustum is \[\pi(15)(5\sqrt{73})-\pi(6)(2\sqrt{73})=63\pi\sqrt{73}.\] Including the two circular ends, the total surface area is \[63\pi\sqrt{73}+15^2\pi+6^2\pi =\pi(63\sqrt{73}+261).\] Since \[\pi(63\sqrt{73}+261)>2500,\] the claim is correct.

(i) Mark claims that the sum of the volumes of the water and the metal sphere is greater than \(55000\text{ mm}^3\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.

questions.stemZh:
13. 一個底半徑 \(4\) cm、高 \(5\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐形容器盛水至深度 \(3.5\) cm。現將全部水倒入一個底半徑 \(2.1\) cm 的空直立圓柱杯，且沒有溢出。

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的總表面積。（2 分）

(a) Let the radii of X and the whole cone be r and R. Similarity gives \(R=5r/3\). Thus \(31360=\frac{30}{3}(R^2+Rr+r^2)=\frac{490}{9}r^2\), so \(r=24\) cm and \(R=40\) cm.

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求水的體積。（2 分）

(b) 將一個半徑 \(3\) cm 的金屬球放入容器，球完全浸入水中。

(a) Similarity gives the water radius \(r=3h/4\), so \(V(h)=3\pi h^3/16\). At depth 8 cm, \(V=96\pi\text{ cm}^3\).

questions.stem:
13. There are two similar inverted right circular conical vessels. For the larger vessel, the base radius and the slant height are \(45\) cm and \(51\) cm respectively. It is given that the ratio of the curved surface area of the larger vessel to that of the smaller vessel is \(9:4\).

(a) Express the capacity of the smaller vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) \(15500\pi\text{ cm}^3\) of water is now poured into the larger vessel. Then, four solid metal spheres of radius \(6\) cm are put into the vessel and are totally immersed. The water that overflows is then collected by the smaller vessel.

(i) Express the volume of water overflowed in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) Someone claims that the area of the wet curved surface of the smaller vessel does not exceed \(670\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 有兩個相似的倒置直立圓錐形容器。較大容器的底半徑及斜高分別為 \(45\) cm 及 \(51\) cm。已知較大容器與較小容器的曲面面積比為 \(9:4\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示較小容器的容量。

(b) 現將 \(15500\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 水倒入較大容器，再放入四個半徑 \(6\) cm 的實心金屬球，球完全浸入水中。溢出的水由較小容器盛載。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求溢出的水體積。
(ii) 某人聲稱較小容器的濕曲面面積不超過 \(670\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.

球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The height of the larger vessel is \[\sqrt{51^2-45^2}=24\text{ cm}.\] The capacity of the larger vessel is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(45)^2(24).\] Since the ratio of curved surface areas is \(9:4\), the linear scale factor from the larger vessel to the smaller vessel is \(3:2\), and the volume scale factor is \(27:8\). Therefore, the capacity of the smaller vessel is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(45)^2(24)\left(\frac{4}{9}\right)^{3/2}=4800\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b)(i) The volume overflowed is \(15500\pi+4\left(\frac{4}{3}\pi(6)^3\right)-\frac{1}{3}\pi(45)^2(24).\) Thus the volume overflowed is \(452\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (ii) The area of the wet curved surface in the smaller vessel is \[\pi(45)(51)\left(\frac{4}{9}\right) \left(\frac{452\pi}{4800\pi}\right)^{2/3}.\] This is approximately \[663.2564917\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[663.2564917<670,\] the claim is agreed.

11. 一個底半徑 \(12\) cm、高 \(9\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐形容器盛水至深度 \(6\) cm。現將全部水倒入一個空直立圓柱杯且沒有溢出，水深為 \(12.8\) cm。

11. An inverted right circular conical vessel contains some water. The vessel is held vertically. The depth of water in the vessel is \(12\text{ cm}\). \(950\pi\text{ cm}^3\) of water is poured into the vessel. It is given that the depth of water in the vessel becomes \(18\text{ cm}\).

(a) Find the final volume of water in the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Someone claims that the area of the wet curved surface of the vessel is at most \(1100\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(6 marks)
questions.stemZh:
11. 一個倒置直立圓錐形容器盛有一些水，容器垂直放置。水深為 \(12\) cm。再倒入 \(950\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 水後，水深變為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求容器中最終的水體積。

(b) 某人聲稱容器的濕曲面面積最多為 \(1100\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（6 分）

排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 11. (a) Let the final volume of water be \(x\text{ cm}^3\). Since the depths before and after pouring are \(12\text{ cm}\) and \(18\text{ cm}\), the volume ratio is \[12^3:18^3=8:27.\] Thus \[\frac{x-950\pi}{x}=\frac{8}{27}.\] Hence \[27(x-950\pi)=8x.\] So \[19x=25650\pi,\] and \[x=1350\pi.\] Therefore, the final volume is \[1350\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) Let \(r\text{ cm}\) be the radius of the water surface after pouring. Then \[\frac13\pi r^2(18)=1350\pi.\] Hence \[ r=15. \] The slant height of the wet cone is \[\sqrt{15^2+18^2}=\sqrt{549}.\] The wet curved surface area is \[\pi(15)\sqrt{549}\approx 1104.148\text{ cm}^2.\] Since this is greater than \(1100\text{ cm}^2\), I disagree with the claim.

(a) (i) Find the radius of the water surface.
(ii) Find the area of the wet curved surface of the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Kelly turns the vessel upside down.

(ii) Kelly claims that the wet curved surface of the vessel has increased. Do you agree? Explain your answer.

questions.stemZh:
一個封閉的倒置直立圓錐形容器內有一些水。圓錐底半徑為 18 cm、高為 24 cm，初始水深為 8 cm。
(a)(i) 求水面半徑。
(ii) 以圓周率表示容器的濕曲面面積。
(b) Kelly 把容器上下倒轉。
(i) 求新水深，準確至一位小數。
(ii) Kelly 聲稱容器的濕曲面面積增加了。你是否同意？解釋答案。（7 分）

questions.solution: 13. (a)(i) Let \(r\) cm be the radius of the water surface. By similar triangles, \[\frac{r}{18}=\frac{8}{24}.\] Thus \(r=6.\) The radius of the water surface is \(6\) cm. (a)(ii) The slant height of the wet cone is \(\sqrt{6^2+8^2}=10.\) The wet curved surface area is \(\pi(6)(10)=60\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (b)(i) The volume of water is \(\frac13\pi(6)^2(8)=96\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) The capacity of the vessel is \(\frac13\pi(18)^2(24)=2592\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) The volume of the empty space is \(2592\pi-96\pi=2496\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) Let \(H\) cm be the height of the empty cone after turning the vessel upside down. By similarity, \(\frac{\frac13\pi\left(\frac{18}{24}H\right)^2H}{2592\pi}=\frac{2496}{2592}.\) Equivalently, \(\left(\frac{H}{24}\right)^3=\frac{26}{27}.\) Thus \(H\approx 23.69996855.\) The new depth of water is \(24-23.69996855\approx0.3\text{ cm}.\) (b)(ii) Let \(R\) cm be the radius of the empty cone after turning the vessel upside down. Then \(\frac{R}{18}=\frac{H}{24},\) so \(R\approx17.77497641.\) The slant height of the empty cone is \(\sqrt{H^2+R^2}\approx29.62496069.\) The curved surface area of the whole cone is \(\pi(18)(30)=540\pi.\) The dry curved surface area is approximately \(\pi(17.77497641)(29.62496069)\approx526.6\pi.\) Therefore the new wet curved surface area is approximately \(540\pi-526.6\pi=13.4\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) Since \(13.4\pi<60\pi,\) the wet curved surface has not increased. I do not agree with Kelly's claim. (7 marks)

(a) The pyramid is inverted and divided into a frustum and a smaller pyramid by a plane which is parallel to its base. It is given that the height of the frustum is \(9\) cm. Find the volume of the frustum.

(b) A container consists of two parts with a common base. The upper part is the frustum described in (a) and the lower part is a cuboid of height \(8\) cm. Water is poured into the container to a depth of \(11\) cm. Find the volume of the water in the container.

questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心直立錐體的底面為邊長 \(20\) cm 的正方形，高為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 將錐體倒置，被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐及一個小錐體。已知截頭錐高 \(9\) cm，求截頭錐的體積。

(b) 一個容器由兩部分組成，共享同一底面。上部為 

(a) 所述的截頭錐，下部為高 \(8\) cm 的長方體。將水倒入容器至深度 \(11\) cm，求容器中水的體積。
（7 分）

錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。

questions.solution: 14. (a) The volume of the original pyramid is \[\frac13(20)^2(18)=2400\text{ cm}^3.\] The height of the smaller pyramid is \[18-9=9\text{ cm}.\] The ratio of the heights of the smaller pyramid and the original pyramid is \[9:18=1:2.\] Therefore, the ratio of their volumes is \[1^3:2^3=1:8.\] The volume of the smaller pyramid is \[\frac{1}{8}(2400)=300\text{ cm}^3.\] Hence the volume of the frustum is \[2400-300=2100\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The lower cuboid has square base of side \(10\) cm, so the volume of water in the cuboid is \[10^2(8)=800\text{ cm}^3.\] Since the water depth is \(11\) cm, the height of water in the frustum is \[11-8=3\text{ cm}.\] The corresponding similar pyramids have heights \(12\) cm and \(9\) cm, so their height ratio is \[12:9=4:3.\] The volume of the pyramid of height \(9\) cm is \(300\text{ cm}^3\). Thus the volume of the pyramid of height \(12\) cm is \[300\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)^3=\frac{6400}{9}\text{ cm}^3.\] Therefore, the volume of water in the frustum part is \[\frac{6400}{9}-300=\frac{3700}{9}\text{ cm}^3.\] The total volume of water is \[800+\frac{3700}{9} =\frac{10900}{9} \approx 1210\text{ cm}^3\] correct to 3 significant figures.

The painting cost for a solid with surface area \(200 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) is \(\$ 300\) while the painting cost for a solid with surface area \(250 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) is \(\$ 360\). Suppose the surface area of solid \(A\) is \(720 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) and the volume of Solid \(A\) is \(1000 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). (a) Find the painting cost of \(\operatorname{solid} A\). (b) Solids \(A\) and \(B\) are similar solids. The painting cost of solid \(A\) is at \(40 \%\) higher than that of solid \(B\). Mary claims that the volume of solid \(B\) is at least \(580 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (4 marks) (a) Let \(\$ C\) be the painting cost of a solid and \(S \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) be its surface area. Let \(C=k_{1}+k_{2} S\), where \(k_{1}\) and \(k_{2}\) are non-zero constants. So, we have \(300=k_{1}+k_{2}(200)\) and \(360=k_{1}+k_{2}(250)\). 1 M either Solving, we have \(k_{1}=60\) and \(k_{2}=1.2\). both correct Painting cost of solid \(A\) \[=\$[60+1.2(720)]\] \[=\underline{\underline{\$ 924}}\] (b) Let \(V_{A} \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) and \(V_{B} \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volumes of solids \(A\) and \(B\) respectively, and let \(S_{A} \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) and \(S_{B} \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) be the surface area of solids \(A\) and \(B\) respectively. The painting cost of the Solid \(B=\$ 924 \div(1+40 \%)\) \(=\underline{\underline{\$ 660}}\) \(660=60+1.2 S_{B}\) \(S_{B}=500\) Note that solids \(A\) and \(B\) are similar. \(\frac{V_{A}}{V_{B}}=\left(\frac{S_{A}}{S_{B}}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}\) \(\frac{1000}{V_{B}}=\left(\frac{720}{500}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}\) \(V_{B} \approx 578.7037037<580\) Thus, the claim is incorrect. f.t. ----(4)
